title: Website first screen: the results lead the Results window (the floor-area allowance, then the legal ceiling beside the apartment estimate), the assumed conditions below them (D-094 R151)
objective: In the Results floating window, make the architect-facing results lead the first screen as on report page 1, and stop the "Assumed conditions" list from occupying the first screen. Add a full-width lead region to ThreeAnswersPanel that renders, in page-1 order, the identity, the one status strip, the Floor-area allowance card, and immediately below it the existing ApartmentFigures block (Legal ceiling 29 Conditional beside Estimate 17-22 Provisional with its distinction line). Keep the existing 44:56 detail grid (.ta-layout with three-answers-left / three-answers-right) BELOW the lead: its left column keeps permitted envelope, building option, FirstBuildingOptions and "What needs resolving"; its right column keeps ScopeSummary with all 13 assumed conditions still open (R119) — now beneath the results band instead of filling the first screen's right half. This is a placement/reading-order change only: no number, label, certainty word or fixed wording changes; three-answers.ts, ApartmentFigures.tsx, ScopeSummary.tsx and presentation-tokens.json stay untouched. Because the lead sits ABOVE an unchanged .ta-layout grid, the existing results-layout.flag-on.spec.ts S1 (44:56 via .ta-layout/three-answers-left) and S12 (identity + allowance headline in the first screen, focus on the heading) keep passing UNEDITED; the new first-screen coverage goes in a NEW spec file owned only by this task, so M5-T181 edits none of M5-T167's files.
business_reason: Owner's outside reviewer, 2026-10-14, captured as D-094 R151 (obligation) in project-control/directives/D-094-report-v2-review-next-pass/source-021-amendment.md: "The visible screen still gives substantial space to assumptions while results sit farther down," together with "keeping the website redesign ... marked incomplete." The orchestrator's recorded reading of R151: the results must lead the first screen as on report page 1, and the independent visual review of M5-T171 (which had judged the ceiling/estimate block's place below the first screen ADVISORY) is superseded for this website task. The directive capture verified the defect directly: the apartment-figures block sits below the first screen at every width (top 1151-1583 px; preview notes 1296 px desktop / 1380 px phone at main 30762409), and the Results window's right 56fr column renders the full "Assumed conditions" list in the first screen. Contract authority: ARCHITECT_PRESENTATION_CONTRACT.md principle 1 ("Architect-facing results come first; the material qualification next"), the first-screen objective (section 2, line 124/175), and page-1 order (results in large type -> site graphic -> legal ceiling beside apartment estimate -> at most three uncertainties).

risks: Results window height is capped at min(690, viewport) by FloatingWorkspaceWindow (wide window min(1100, width) x min(690, height), centered). The ~690 px dialog bounds how much of the lead fits in the first screen; the lead (identity + strip + allowance + apartment-figures, ~480-520 px stacked) fits with margin, but the builder must CONFIRM in the CI Playwright run that ceiling-value and estimate-value land in the first screen at every desktop width. Do NOT change the shared window height in this task (it would move all tools: map, proposal, study, report, evidence, results, and floating-workspace-window.test.tsx); if a width cannot fit, raise the results-scoped-height open question rather than editing the shared component.

M5-T167 file overlap (task-premise correction): M5-T167.json allowed_paths include apps/web/e2e/results-layout.flag-on.spec.ts, apps/web/e2e/results.flag-on.spec.ts, apps/web/e2e/report-print.flag-on.spec.ts and apps/web/e2e/harness/fixture_api.py — not only services/api, packages/contracts/fixtures, docs/research and docs/zoning-rule-review as the task framing assumed. M5-T181 avoids all four by forbidding them and adding a NEW spec file (results-first-screen.flag-on.spec.ts); the orchestrator must still ensure M5-T167's producer does not touch those e2e specs so the two tasks truly share no file (CLAUDE.md principle 10).

Keeping the .ta-layout grid (so S1 stays green unedited) means the assumptions' right column still starts mid-first-screen on desktop; the results now lead ABOVE them (fixes R151's ordering: results no longer sit farther down than assumptions) but the assumptions are not pushed entirely below the fold. Full demotion would require restructuring the grid and editing the shared results-layout.flag-on.spec.ts S1 — which collides with M5-T167. Flagged as an open question.

Do NOT trim or cap the 13 assumed conditions: R119 keeps them open and the forbidden journey-215-16-northern.test.tsx (asserts 13 rows) and scope-summary.test.tsx pin all of them. The contract's 'at most three notices with a count' clause is the NOTICES cap (status strip / SharedConditions via capNotices), not the assumed-conditions list. Demote, never cap.
The new e2e spec must define its own routeApi/openResults helpers (the existing ones are not exported and their file is forbidden). Acceptable e2e duplication; note it in the producer report.

Container query: the lead region and the .ta-layout grid share the Results window's inline-size container (container-type is on the workspace window content, handed to results-panel.css), so the grid's @container (min-width:1000px) 44:56 switch is unaffected; any 2-up treatment of the lead must use the same container so it switches at the same 1000 px.

Pure placement change: moving the allowance AnswerCard and the ApartmentFigures JSX inside ThreeAnswersPanel must not alter their props or testids; ApartmentFigures.tsx and AnswerCard.tsx stay untouched (forbidden), so answer-floor_area_allowance, answer-headline-number, apartment-figures-ceiling-value and apartment-figures-estimate-value keep working for the existing queries.
path_notes: Web only; runs beside M5-T167 (services/api, packages/contracts/fixtures, docs/research, docs/zoning-rule-review and four apps/web/e2e files listed in M5-T167's packet) and shares no file with it: those four e2e files are forbidden here and the new first-screen coverage goes in the new spec file this task owns. Plan: two independent read-only plans and a judged synthesis (session-2026-10-14d/return-plan-T181-A.md, -B.md, return-plan-T181-spec.json; workflow wf_cca9eb2c-bcc).
